entries.title: Ask the first mate to loop until a goal is met
entries.body: Ask the first mate to keep at a goal until it is met, such as "loop until the tests pass", or say "use a workflow", and it files the work as one program: rounds that each continue the last until the goal is met, an audit that checks every finding, deep research that brings its answers together, or a change made item by item. You review one result at the end.
entries.noPicture: A program shows as an ordinary task with its pieces as child tasks, so there is no new view.
